stops.title: Rijɔn dɛn
stops.caption: Branch dɛn we dɛn grup bay ples.
stops.speech: Rijɔn de grup branch dɛn bay ples, so dat ripɔt kin kɔva wan kɔntri ɛn nɔto wan ples at a tɛm.

stops.title: Branch dɛn we Tay
stops.caption: Rijɔn we gɛt branch nɔ kin dilit.
stops.speech: Ɛvri rijɔn de sho di branch dɛn we tay pan am. Wan we gɛt branch nɔ go dilit sote dɛn muv ɛvri branch.
